name: Meritous
author: ASCEAI, Cralex
description_short: Top-down dungeon action game. Explore the Orcus Dome as Merit, fight hostile beings with psi powers and collect crystals to upgrade them.
description_long: You play as Merit on a quest through the Orcus Dome, a large underground structure of interconnected rooms filled with hostile beings and valuable artifacts. Your psi power attacks everything within a radius around you in the same room. Charge it for a stronger blast, but the bigger the charge, the longer it takes to recharge. Collect crystals along the way to upgrade your psi abilities: charging, recharging and the reflect shield. Music is not included.
